answer: To resist sybils, agents must each maintain an independent live sensor stream of one fixed outdoor scene containing a grassy knoll, a still lagoon, and a mature cedar tree, committing every hour to a hash of the raw frame plus GPS and clock. An attacker scaling identities must either buy and position a fresh camera for each head or run a perfect real-time video synthesizer whose compute cost scales linearly with the number of fakes; honest agents reuse one physical setup.
